seriesTitle: May I Ask for One Final Thing?

episodes.title: May I Kindly Beat the Tar Out of Those Evil Nobles (Pigs)?
episodes.summary: When "villainess" Scarlet's fiancé dumps her at a ball, she requests an unexpected form of satisfaction.

episodes.title: May I Offer You the Taste of My Fist as the Ladylike Thing to Do?
episodes.summary: Scarlet's behavior at the ball has unexpected consequences, including a direct attempt on her life!

episodes.title: I Considered a Negotiated Resolution, but May I Biff and Pow those Noblemen Instead?
episodes.summary: To take down the kingdom's slave trader, Scarlet negotiates access to the upcoming slave auction.

episodes.title: May I Go To See My Fists' Beloved One (Punching Bag)?
episodes.summary: Scarlet infiltrates the slave auction, but her priority is to find and pummel Lord Godwin.

episodes.title: May I Clobber This Asshole Prince?
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the slave auction raid, Scarlet and Julius consider their next moves.

episodes.title: May I Send This Pig Flying Into The Sky?
episodes.summary: Scarlet is to accompany Saint Diana's Holy Land Pilgrimage, but the servants of Palmianism stand in her way.

episodes.title: May I Carry Out a Plan That Shows a New Side of You?
episodes.summary: Diana explores new feelings while Scarlet explores a festival looking for new people to punch.

episodes.title: May I Offer You a Fist In Place of a Handkerchief?
episodes.summary: The pilgrimage proceeds to Snowind, where Scarlet and her crew receive a less than warm welcome.

episodes.title: May I Explain That This Is Not Something That Just Anyone Can Do?
episodes.summary: While threats approach from all sides, Diana is racked with guilt over Scarlet's condition.

episodes.title: May I Cook This Thick Cut of Pork Through with Body Punches?
As These Appear Undercooked, May I Turn Them Into Mince Meat?
episodes.summary: Scarlet and her friends continue to deal with the external threats, but the source of the problem remains.

episodes.title: May I Pay Off the Massive Debt My Fists Have Accrued?
episodes.summary: Scarlet pursues a final reckoning with Terenezza, but the would-be heroine has a cruel plan in store.

episodes.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
episodes.summary: Scarlet is ready to deal her last punch to Terenezza, but she must first overcome a mind-controlled Julius.
